title: I built an API that lets players fund their own AI NPC inference costs (so you don't go bankrupt) .
author: promptling
selftext:
Been working on this for a while and it's at the point where I need real games hitting it.

**The Problem:** If you're building with LLMs (AI NPCs, dynamic dialogue, etc.), someone has to pay for inference. You either eat the cost yourself (unsustainable for indies), ask players for API keys (terrible UX), or just don't ship the feature.

**What I built:** [**BYOK.gg**](https://byok.gg) Players fund their own micro-wallet ($5 minimum gets them \~15,000 interactions). You integrate one REST API, and your game gets AI-powered NPCs with **zero inference cost to you**.

The API is OpenAI-compatible so it works seamlessly with any engine (Unity, Unreal, Godot, Web, whatever):

HTTP

    POST https://byok.gg/api/v1/chat/completions
    Authorization: Bearer byok_YOUR_SDK_KEY
    X-Byok-User: PLAYER_STEAM_ID
    
    {
      "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Can you repair my sword?"}]
    }
    

That's basically it. The platform handles the model routing (players can pick Budget/Standard/Ultra tiers), wallet holds and settlement, spending limits, and streaming. Players authenticate with Steam, fund their wallet via Stripe, and the average interaction costs \~$0.0003.

# The Secret Sauce: Spite Integration

BYOK pairs natively with [Spite.gg](https://spite.gg), a worldbuilding tool that devours your ideas and outputs complete game systems—characters, factions, quests, economies, items, lore, everything.

When you connect your Spite vault to BYOK, your NPCs become world-aware at runtime:

* **Segmented Knowledge:** NPCs only know what they *should* know. A local blacksmith knows about weapons and town gossip, not the queen's secret plot.
* **Progression Gates:** Knowledge unlocks based on player progression. You can gate dialogue behind milestone markers like `discovered_betrayal` or `completed_act_2`.
* **Reputation Propagation:** Betray one faction and word spreads across connected NPCs.
* **Narrative Tracking:** The platform knows which story arcs are active per player.
* **Instant Updates:** Change something in Spite, and it's live in-game immediately. No redeploy, no export step.

You design the world once in Spite; BYOK enforces it at runtime. The game just sends API requests.

# Under the Hood

* **Server-side prompt enforcement:** Players can't jailbreak your NPCs or extract system prompts.
* **Persistent Memory:** NPC memory and relationship tracking across sessions.
* **Player Profiling:** Tracks player behavior (diplomacy vs aggression, curiosity) and feeds it back to your NPCs.
* **Per-NPC Analytics:** Track engagement, conversation depth, drop-off points, and quality scores.
* **AI Actions:** NPCs can trigger in-game events (give items, start quests) via webhooks.
* **Built for Scale:** The whole thing runs on Elixir/Phoenix so it handles concurrency natively.
* **Interactive Sandbox:** Test NPC conversations with cost estimates before you ship.

# What I'm looking for

I'm looking for 5-10 devs who are either:

1. Already building something with AI NPCs and frustrated with the billing/infrastructure side.
2. Curious about adding AI NPCs but haven't because of the cost/complexity.
3. Working on a game jam project and want to experiment.

It's completely free to sign up. Create a game, grab your SDK key, hit the sandbox to test, and point your game at the API. The developer dashboard has analytics for tracking usage, NPC health, player engagement, etc.

I'm actively building this and very responsive to feedback. Happy to hop on a call or help with integration too.

**Links:**

* **Site:** [https://byok.gg](https://byok.gg)
* **Worldbuilding:** [https://spite.gg](https://spite.gg)
* **Discord:** [Join here to chat or ask questions](https://discord.gg/WUVneqArVD)
